item.title: Hyundai closes in on Volkswagen as China dependence bites
item.summary: Global auto sales in the first half of 2026 show Toyota still firmly in first place, while the gap between No. 2 Volkswagen and No. 3 Hyundai Motor has narrowed sharply. Volkswagen's heavy dependence on China has dragged sales lower, while Hyundai has held up through diversified geopolitical exposure, local production, and a flexible product mix. Market attention is now turning to whether Hyundai is on the verge of overtaking Volkswagen for the No. 2 spot.
